reviews.scope: Source-bound lock-acquisition and Pending->Running transition subpath with minimal state; plus structural assertions that no state lock is held across generation or the publish step. No complete FFI, public polling recovery, model, GPU, installation or hardware qualification.
reviews.review_scope: Author re-bind after the async worker was restructured (inference gate, staged output, Running->Publishing state machine); the earlier independent approval applied to the previous source.
reviews.review_reason: build.rs now extracts lock_state_recovering and begin_async_request verbatim and asserts into_inner recovery, no panic on poison, and no state lock between begin_async_request and generate() or between begin_publish and finish_publish. The probe checks the transition leaves the lock free (poll/cancel responsive), preserves unrelated requests, and recovers a poisoned mutex without relocking or clearing poison. Negative controls: replacing into_inner with a panic, or taking a global lock across the publish step, fails the build. The earlier independent approval and its receipt hash do not carry over.
reviews.validation: Windows x64 native Rust: python -m unittest discover -s Tests/Portable -p test_media_worker_lock.py, 3 passes; two source copies with the regressions above fail at build.rs assertions; the CRLF controls in Tests/Portable/test_media_worker_lock_crlf.py (CRLF source generates identical probe code, regressed CRLF source still refused) pass and failed before build.rs normalised line endings. Not independently reviewed.
